Upper Text: While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [LIBERATOR] trait, you may ignore this card's color requirements.

[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait among them to your hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck in any order. Then, you may play 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait and a play cost of 3 or less from your hand without paying the cost.
